title: Go to the Moon
summary: 玩具火箭假装+睡前:主角拿玩具火箭在家假装飞去月亮,爸爸喊睡觉,床上看月亮入睡。
text: {{name}} has a rocket. It is a toy rocket. It is red and white. {{name}} looks at the sky. The moon is big. The stars are little. "I can go to the moon!" {{name}} runs with the rocket. Up, up, up! "Look at me! I can fly!" Dad comes home. "{{name}}, come to bed." "Dad, I like the moon." "You can see it in bed." {{name}} is in bed. The moon looks at {{name}}. Good night, little one.

questions.prompt: What is big in the sky?
